They're bringing out tankier menaces!|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 14 ([[Easy Mode|Easy]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Armored''' is an enemy that appears in [[Easy Mode|Easy]], [[Casual Mode|Casual]], [[Challenge Trials]], Basic Arena [[PVP]] and Molten Arena [[PVP]] modes. It also appears in [[The Takeover Event]]. It also appears in the tutorial and first chapters of [[Story Mode|Story]] mode. It has decent health, though less than the [[Normal Boss]] and [[Elite Abnormal]]. It makes up for this with a decent speed, as well as an average amount of defense, which makes it take less damage from most sources of damage. Additionally, it often spawns with multiple attributes which make it harder to kill. The '''Armored''' can be summoned by the [[Grave Digger]]. The '''Armored''' was replaced by the [[Armored Toilet]] in [[Headache Headquarters]]. ==Appearance== The '''Armored''' has a green skin color and a black torso and legs. It wears a grey riot helmet with a chipped grey visor, shoulder-pads, knee-pads and a tactical bullet vest. ==Strategy== *Beginner towers such as the [[Scout]], [[Sniper]], [[Paintballer]] and [[Soldier]] are enough to take down the '''Armored''' if enough of them are placed and upgraded. **Cheap towers with decent DPS, like the [[Ace Pilot]], [[Assassin]], [[Militant]] or [[Cowboy]] can also be very effective against the '''Armored'''. *Splash damage towers, such as the [[Demoman]] and [[Rocketeer]], are useful against the '''Armored''' as it normally spawns in hordes. *You can use towers like the [[Pyromancer]] or [[Freezer]] to reduce its defense, although it is not necessary as its health is negligible. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} ArmoredWalk.gif|Current walk animation (24 February 2024 – Present) ArmoredStunAnimation.gif|Current stun animation (24 February 2024 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1Armored.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) DefHacker2Armored.png|Overclock variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseArmored.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} V2.1.0GenericThumbnail8.png|'''Armored''' on the game thumbnail.
